palette.primary_role: Page background, hero section bg, header bg (dark mode dominant, metallic feel)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons, price highlights, special offers, key specs callouts
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (dark: near-black metallic, light: off-white cream), section alternation
palette.neutral_role: Body text on dark bg, specs text, secondary information, disclaimers
palette.border_role: Card borders (dark: subtle metallic, light: soft gray), input borders, dividers

button_styles.text: action-oriented (Book Service, Schedule Test Drive, Get Quote)
Browse Inventory, View Offers, Learn More

elevation.approach: Clean edge shadows with metallic sheen feel — not glassmorphism but subtle industrial weight

typical_order: header (sticky dark bg, logo left, nav center, phone/CTA right, full-width)
hero (full-width vehicle imagery or video bg + h1 tagline + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA + trust badges)
services (icon + title + description grid, 3 or 4 columns — repair, maintenance, detailing, tires)
inventory_gallery (filterable grid or carousel of vehicle/service images, lightbox on click)
team (photo cards with name, role, certifications — mechanics or sales staff)
reviews (testimonial cards with star ratings, customer names, vehicle models — carousel layout)
booking_cta (centered, accent bg or dark bg, 'Schedule Your Service' or 'Book a Test Drive', phone number prominent)
footer (4-column: dealership info/contact/social, services, hours, legal + map embed)
hero_variants: full_bleed_vehicle (BMW style — vehicle photo full-width, dark overlay, text left-aligned)
video_background (Tesla style — cinematic vehicle video loop, minimal text overlay)
split_layout (CarMax style — photo left, search/inventory tool right)
service_hero (Firestone style — bold typography, price offers, quick booking form)
feature_card_variants: icon_grid (service cards: icon + title + description + 'Learn more' link)
vehicle_card (image + year/make/model + price + mileage + CTA button)
testimonial_card (5-star rating + quote + customer name + vehicle + date)

tone_profile.headline_style: short, powerful, under 6 words (e.g., 'Precision Performance. Unmatched Service.', 'Drive Your Dream.')
tone_profile.cta_style: direct action verbs (Book, Schedule, Browse, Test Drive, Get Quote, Call Now)
anti_patterns: generic stock photos of smiling mechanics

color_mood: luxury_metallic (Mercedes-Benz: #0a0a0a bg, #d4af37 gold accent, chrome highlights)
racing_red (Ferrari/Ducati: #cc0000 primary, #ffffff text, black accents, aggressive feel)
electric_blue (Tesla/Rivian: #111111 bg, #2563eb blue accent, white text, clean futuristic)
industrial_dark (Firestone/Pep Boys: #1a1a1a bg, #ff4d00 orange accent, yellow safety highlights)
premium_monochrome (Audi/BMW: #f5f5f7 bg, #0a0a0a text, subtle silver accents, minimal chrome)
typography_mood: oswald_bold (Oswald headings, Inter body — authoritative, industrial, high-impact)
montserrat_premium (Montserrat headings and body — polished, modern dealership feel)
bebas_statement (Bebas Neue headings, Source Sans 3 body — bold, editorial, magazine-like)
layout_density: full_bleed_spacious (BMW/Porsche: large hero, lots of negative space, cinematic)
service_dense (Firestone/Jiffy Lube: more CTAs per viewport, quick booking visible immediately)
inventory_grid (CarMax/AutoNation: vehicle cards dominant, filter sidebar, search-first layout)

inventory_page.best_practices: Filter sidebar or top bar with make/model/year/price, vehicle cards with photo + key specs + price, comparison tool
